title: DynamicValidationScenarioSet
description: A set of dynamic-validation scenarios for a SourceOS image. Each scenario is a GUI/OS automation flow driven by Agent-S (simular-ai computer-use agent) inside a controller container against a DISPOSABLE guest VM. This is validation truth: it declares WHAT to exercise on a running image and WHAT evidence to record. Execution (Agent-S + the guest VM) is HOST-GATED and lives in the controller runner (tools/dynamic-validation/run.py). The recorded EvidenceBundle feeds the ReleaseEvidenceBundle consumed by the Katello evidence gate (infra/ansible/roles/katello_lifecycle_sourceos/tasks/evidence_gate.yml).

targetImage.description: The artifact under validation. The runner boots this in a disposable guest VM.

artifactRef.description: Path to the ISO/disk image to validate, relative to the workspace root or absolute.

guest.description: Disposable guest VM profile. MUST be disposable: created fresh per run, destroyed after. The runner refuses to reuse a guest across scenario sets.

disposable.description: Hard requirement: the guest is throwaway. Red-team scenarios may leave the guest in an untrusted state.

networkProfile.description: isolated = no egress (default, safe); nat = host-NAT for network scenarios; offline = no NICs.

snapshotBeforeRun.description: Take a base snapshot so rollback/update and red-team scenarios can revert.

step.description: One Agent-S-drivable action. The runner maps `action` to an Agent-S computer-use instruction (gui_*) or a policy-gated host/guest command (host_command / guest_command).

action.description: Action verb. gui_* are computer-use (vision+grounding) actions Agent-S performs against the guest framebuffer; *_command are deterministic commands. host_command is policy-gated (see policy/dynamic-validation-host-actions.yaml).

target.description: Natural-language UI target for gui_click/gui_wait_for (grounded by Agent-S), or the command string for *_command actions.

text.description: Text to type (gui_type) or key chord (gui_key, e.g. 'ctrl+alt+t').

expected.description: Pass/fail oracle for the scenario. ALL listed conditions must hold for the scenario to PASS.

uiContains.description: Strings Agent-S OCR must find on-screen at the end of the flow.

uiAbsent.description: Strings that must NOT appear (e.g. error dialogs, crash text).

guestCommandExit.description: Map of guest command -> required exit code.

serialMatches.description: Regexes expected in the guest serial log (reuses the boot-smoke serial oracle).

evidence_requirements.description: What the EvidenceBundle MUST carry for this scenario. The runner refuses to mark a scenario PASS unless every required artifact is present.

actionTrace.description: Record the full ordered Agent-S action trace (instruction, grounded coordinates, result).

ocrGrounding.description: Record OCR text + element-grounding metadata per gui action.

replayRef.description: Emit a replay reference (guest snapshot id + scenario hash) so the run is re-derivable, mirroring the reasoning-evidence ReplayPlan shape.

serialLog.description: Capture the guest serial log alongside the GUI trace.

id.description: Stable scenario id, unique within the set.

covers.description: IDs of the 13 Linux image validation categories this scenario contributes to (see docs/sourceos/dynamic-validation-coverage-v0.md, e.g. 'LIV-01').

safetyClass.description: destructive scenarios (red-team, rollback) require guest.snapshotBeforeRun and an isolated/offline network unless network-storage explicitly needs egress.
